configuration.kernel_protocol: fresh per-rank generated-kernel build before the synchronized timed region of every launch
configuration.launcher_scope: single launcher-visible host; no hostfile arguments
configuration.mpi_rank_binding: Open MPI: retained explicit rankfile, one selected processor per rank, plus --report-bindings

linear.preconditioner: additive fieldsplit with GAMG per scalar field

configuration.warmup_policy: no discarded warm-ups; every fresh launch is retained and aggregated

metric_grain: one fixed-size coupled solve per rank count and repeat
